scoring_rule: For a declared comparable domain, report local simulator-vs-NCU accuracy and simulator speed. Accuracy passes only when error <= the published target ceiling; throughput/speedup passes only when value >= the published floor. Literature rows are aggregate targets, never per-kernel ground truth.
unmatched_policy: Retain the row as an aspirational lower-bound reference and report lower_bound_reference_unmatched until workload, metric, endpoint, and hardware scope are explicitly mapped. Do not silently normalize incompatible units.

record_contract.rule: Different hardware prevents per-kernel ground-truth transfer but does not invalidate a published lower-bound target; direct attainment requires a declared metric/endpoint/workload mapping and local NCU ground truth.

extraction_provenance.review_status: values transcribed from retained primary-source matrix; source-specific locator/digest must be checked before marking a row floor_comparable
extraction_provenance.source_digest_policy: URLs alone do not establish freshness; retain this content-bound local extraction identity and source locator.

target_selection_policy.accuracy: Retain architecture-family rows; for a declared modern aggregate target use the smallest published error ceiling only when the workload/hardware/endpoint mapping is defensible. Do not average unlike rows.
target_selection_policy.throughput: Compare only the same throughput denominator and host/toolchain protocol; trace-driven and execution-driven KIPS are separate lanes.
target_selection_policy.wall_speedup: Compare only against the named reference system and benchmark protocol; do not compare to event-vs-dense local speed.

scope: This manifest intentionally registers Accel-Sim 1.0 and Accel-Sim 2.0 aggregate claims. Huerta/FlashGPU-Sim/other systems remain in the SOTA matrix and are not silently merged into Accel-Sim floors.
